title: Config
intro: {market}'s fees, cancellation terms and timers, and the feature flags. Admins only; every change needs a reason and goes to the audit log.

outage.title: Outage switch
outage.intro: Pauses new bookings and payments in {market} during an incident (the payments incident runbook). Every signed-in page shows a notice while it's on.
outage.openBody: People can book, tip and pay for changes as usual.
outage.pausedBody: Nobody can book an offer, request a helper, accept a rebook or regular visits, tip or pay for a change. Bookings that exist go ahead: scheduled charges, Pay now, refunds and transfers carry on.
outage.pauseDescription: New bookings, tips and paid changes stop at once, and every signed-in page says so. Reopen as soon as the incident is over.
outage.resumeDescription: People can book, tip and pay for changes again, and the notice goes away.

policyIntro: Publishing makes a new version that new bookings use. Existing bookings keep the version they were confirmed under.

fields.freeUntilHours: Free cancellation until (hours before the start)

reasonHint: 10 to 1,000 characters. It's kept in the audit log.
reasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 10 characters.
published: Published. New bookings use the new version.
flagsIntro: Flags apply everywhere unless a market overrides them.
notAllowed: That change isn't possible now. Refresh the page to see the current settings.
